reviews.text:
So I started to apply every evening. The texture absorbs quickly without stickiness. After use, my skin become plumper, deep nourishing, firmer and beautifully glowing. I didn't needed my regular cream. Just one serum who gives a youghtul look without clogging pores, greasiness or irritation.

Definitely, I will use it in the future. It is the best serum I ever had.
reviews.zh:
所以我開始每晚用。質地吸收得好快，唔會黏。用完之後，皮膚變得更飽滿、深層滋養、更緊緻，而且有漂亮嘅光澤。我唔需要再用平時嘅面霜。只係一款精華，就可以令皮膚有返青春感，又唔會堵塞毛孔、油膩或者刺激。

我以後一定會繼續用。佢係我用過最好嘅精華。

reviews.text:
The first time, I was sceptical about Volufiline filler serum’s so-promising formula. 

First impressed me with its elegant design and two-layer texture:
• Cream layer- 5% volufiline
• Serum layer - 17 amino acids + collagen.

I have sensitive combination skin in my 42s, so I'm always looking for anti-ageing skincare that won't be heavy or irritating.
So I started to apply every evening. The texture absorbs quickly without stickiness. After use, my skin become plumper, deep nourishing, firmer and beautifully glowing. I didn't needed my regular cream. Just one serum who gives a youghtul look without clogging pores, greasiness or irritation. 

Definitely, I will use it in the future. It is the best serum I ever had.
reviews.zh:
第一次用，我對 Volufiline 填充精華嗰個聲稱好有效嘅配方半信半疑。

首先，佢嘅設計同雙層質地令我印象深刻：
• 乳霜層——5% volufiline
• 精華層——17 種氨基酸＋膠原蛋白。

我而家 42 歲，皮膚係敏感混合性，所以我一直都想搵抗老化、唔會太厚重或者刺激嘅護膚品。
所以我開始每晚用。質地吸收得好快，唔會黏。用完之後，皮膚變得更飽滿、深層滋養、更緊緻，而且有漂亮嘅光澤。我唔需要再用平時嘅面霜。只係一款精華，就可以令皮膚有返青春感，又唔會堵塞毛孔、油膩或者刺激。

我以後一定會繼續用。佢係我用過最好嘅精華。

reviews.text: Amazing product! I will definitely order it again. I especially noticed great results around the eye area. I have dry skin and fine lines, and my skin became extremely dry after using retinol. This product helped a lot to restore moisture and make my skin feel much more comfortable. Highly recommended!
reviews.zh: 好正嘅產品！我一定會再買。我特別留意到眼周效果好好。我皮膚乾，有幼紋，用咗視黃醇之後，皮膚變得非常乾燥。呢款產品幫我補返好多水分，令皮膚感覺舒服好多。非常推薦！

reviews.text: isn't your typical boring serum—it is a bi-phase formula with a 58% collagen serum layer at the bottom and a 5% cream layer on top. You have to shake it up really well to mix them into a beautiful, milky potion before dropping it onto your face. I was worried it might feel heavy, but it absorbs surprisingly fast without any stickiness. Plus, it is completely fragrance-free.
reviews.zh: 唔係一般乏味嘅精華——佢係雙相配方，底層係 58% 膠原蛋白精華，面層係 5% 乳霜。搽喺面之前要好用力搖勻，先會變成一瓶靚嘅乳白色精華液。我以為佢會好重，但係吸收得出奇咁快，一啲都唔黏。而且，佢完全冇香味。

reviews.text:
Besides all its great ingredients, I really like the applicator—it's convenient and easy to use.

I actually bought this serum because many skincare influencers recommend using it together with another serum from the same brand, saying they work even better as a pair.

It also contains Volufiline, and besides giving my skin a nice glow, after using it for a while I noticed that my skin looked a little plumper. I'm not completely sure if it was this serum alone or the combination of products I started using at the same time. ☺️

But the makes this brand makes are still my absolute favorites.
reviews.zh:
除咗佢嘅好成分之外，我好鍾意佢嘅塗抹頭——方便，易用。

我其實係因為好多護膚網紅推薦，話同同一品牌嘅另一款精華一齊用效果更好，所以先買呢款。

佢仲含有 Volufiline，除咗令皮膚有好靚嘅光澤之外，用咗一段時間之後，我覺得皮膚睇落飽滿咗少少。我唔係好肯定係單靠呢款精華，定係同時開始用嘅其他產品組合。☺️

不過呢個品牌做嘅產品，仍然係我最愛嘅。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the Sungboon Editor Deep Collagen Power Boosting Cream-in-Serum and noticed my skin feels more hydrated, plump, and elastic with regular use. The collagen-focused formula, along with nourishing and moisture-locking ingredients, helps improve the look of fine dryness lines and gives my skin a smoother, firmer appearance. It absorbs well without feeling heavy, and leaves a healthy, dewy finish that lasts through the day. Overall, my skin looks more refreshed and supported, especially in terms of moisture and suppleness.
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊 Sungboon Editor Deep Collagen Power Boosting Cream-in-Serum，發覺持續使用之後，我嘅皮膚感覺更水潤、飽滿同有彈性。以膠原蛋白為重點嘅配方，加上滋養同鎖水成分，有助改善乾紋嘅外觀，令皮膚睇落更滑、更緊緻。佢吸收得好好，唔會覺得沉重，留低健康、水潤嘅光澤，可以維持成日。整體嚟講，我嘅皮膚睇落更加清新、有支撐，特別係水分同彈潤度方面。

reviews.text: What I’ve noticed most is the subtle plumping effect — fine lines look a little softer, and my skin feels firmer. From what I understand, the results build over time, so I’m excited to see even more improvement with continued use. The combination of collagen, niacinamide, and Volufiline makes it feel like a multi-tasker for both elasticity and wrinkle care.
reviews.zh: 我最留意到嘅係佢微微令皮膚飽滿嘅效果——幼紋睇落軟咗少少，皮膚摸落亦都更結實。據我了解，效果會隨時間累積，所以我好期待繼續用落去會見到更多改善。膠原蛋白、菸酰胺同 Volufiline 嘅組合，令佢似一件多功能產品，兼顧彈性同抗皺護理。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
